revenue_growth.source: Assumption: growth slows from FY2025 +11.8% as the company reprices and shrinks unprofitable Medicare Advantage plans; settles near 4% long-run medical cost/enrolment growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin was 4.2% (18,964/447,567) and FY2023-24 were 8.7% and 8.1%. A partial recovery to 5% is assumed (flat), below history because of elevated medical cost trend. Flat input is a simplification, so the reviewer should consider a ramp.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US 21% federal plus state, less other items. Filed FY2025 pretax income was 14,697 and net income 12,056, which implies about 18% effective, so 22% is conservative.

wacc.source: Assumption using CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta 0.9 (my assumption for managed care, not taken from a tool) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 8.9% cost of equity. After-tax cost of debt is about 4.5% to 5%. Debt weight is about 20% (78.4B debt vs a roughly 300B+ market cap, which is an estimate), giving WACC of about 8.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run US nominal GDP growth, discounted for maturity.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: total debt 78,389 (LT debt 72,320 + current debt 6,069) - cash 24,365 - ST investments 3,756; accession 0000731766-26-000062
